body: Nifty peaked at ~26,277 on 27 Sept 2024 (from memory) and fell ~17% to ~21,700-22,000 by Mar-Apr 2025 (US tariff shock; from memory); the Nifty Smallcap 250 fell 24%+ from its Sept 2024 peak to 14,145 on 17 Feb 2025 and had its weakest calendar year in seven years in 2025 (-6 to -7%). Smallcap 250 TRI -24% vs Nifty 50 TRI -8% in the 2025 correction, still below its peak 18 months later (Mar 2026, DSP). FPIs sold a record ~Rs 1.66 lakh crore in 2025; 2026 then saw the US-Iran war (from 28 Feb 2026) and crude above $100: FPI outflows of ~Rs 1.68-1.92 lakh crore in Jan-Apr 2026, ~Rs 2.41 lakh crore for 2026 before November; FPI ownership of NSE firms fell to a 17-year low (~15.8%). The rupee breached 96/USD (record low ~96.5-97.2 in May 2026 per earlier memdb record) vs ~94.2 in mid-Nov. Domestic flows absorbed it: DII inflows ~Rs 8.5 lakh crore in FY26 and SIPs ~Rs 32,000 crore a month. Nifty ~23,700 on 22 May 2026; then recovery: record FPI buying of Rs 84,291 crore in the first half of Nov 2026, led by financials and autos; Nifty 25,228 and Sensex 82,032 on 18 Nov 2026. Valuation (Nov 2026): Nifty ~20.6x trailing; Smallcap 250 forward ~21.9x vs 18.7x average. Lesson: FPI selling plus a weak rupee hits small caps hardest; domestic SIP flows now cushion large caps; FPI capitulation (ownership at 17-year lows) preceded the turn.
title: 2025-26 FPI exodus, smallcap bear market and rupee record low
